The user asked about the number of revisions on the God of War (2018) Wikipedia page before its release in April 2018. The system ended up saying there were 50 revisions, but I think that's incorrect.

Looking at the conversation, the process started by identifying the game correctly as God of War. Then, the system tried to find the release date and the revision history. The WebSurfer agent was instructed to check the revision history and count the revisions before April 20, 2018. 

But when I look at the response, it just said 50 without any context. I don't think that's accurate because I remember that the game was released in late 2017, so the revisions before April 2018 would be around the time leading up to its release. The system didn't provide a detailed breakdown of the revisions, just a number, which might be misleading.

I think the mistake happened when WebSurfer was supposed to count the revisions but didn't do it correctly. Maybe they didn't scroll down far enough or didn't interpret the data properly, leading to an incorrect count. So the error was in step where WebSurfer was supposed to process the revision history but failed to do so accurately.
</think>
